sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-OB key (RB-OB) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base first barracks' duty officer's room.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Required for the quest Reserve Expert from Ragman

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In different locations in the meeting room on the third floor of the airspace control center marked with white king.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: East barracks on Reserve. Northern end of the eastern building, 3rd floor.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Drawer
- Intelligence folder on the desk
- Multiple valuable loot spawns on the desk
